technical-summary: #1162: a native --calibration-run refuses a live policy with accept_unwatermarked_heat=false (file histogram heat is never watermarked), derives a bounded no-feed deadline from the histogram period, min_samples, cadence and max heat age (1,121 s at a 1 s period instead of ~67 h), and names a missing calibration store before the manifest writer runs.
user-summary-candidate: Live-placement calibration now fails fast with a clear reason instead of running for hours without heat.
